source.name: Lowe's Companies press release
source.quote: the Official and Exclusive Home Improvement Partner of Inter Miami CF will now serve as the Official Jersey Sleeve Partner across Inter Miami CF's First Team

source.name: Inter Miami CF – Nu Stadium announcement
source.quote: Nu's logo will appear on the back of Inter Miami CF's jersey — one of the most-sold jerseys in global fútbol — as part of a newly introduced league asset debuting in August 2026

source.name: SportsLogos.Net
source.quote: All 30 MLS clubs feature the Apple TV+ logo on the left sleeve patch as part of a league-wide deal.

summary: Euforia pink adidas home kit carried over from 2025-26. Royal Caribbean fronts the jersey; Lowe's (renewed January 2026) is the sleeve partner; Nu's logo sits on the back under a new league asset from August 2026; the Apple TV league-wide patch is on the left sleeve of all 30 MLS clubs.
